headline: Marginal angle but offshore wind — a decent glassy afternoon log.
today: The S swell's a poor angle for the inlet, so shape is meh, but the wind turns offshore W by afternoon and stays clean into evening. Waist-to-chest and short-period. Wait for the offshore to set up midday and bring a log or groveler. Cleaner than it deserves to be.

daysToWatch.note: Offshore W at dawn on a waist-high swell — get in early before the cross-on fills. Clean small session.
Offshore W morning cleans up a knee-to-chest short-period swell. Dawn window.
Small and offshore but the swell's fading. Marginal at best, log only.
